pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.emptyDetail: A pipeline is the steps a task runs through: which agent profile or tool does each step, where it waits for you, and where the work goes back when a check fails. Tasks can use a pipeline once it is published.
pipelines.emptyCreationHint: Create v1 saves a pipeline once every step is ready. Nothing is saved before.
pipelines.starterLibraryHint: 6 steps · 2 approval gates · Review can send the work back to Implement
pipelines.versionLineUnsaved: Not saved yet: {{next}} · used by {{tasks}} tasks
pipelines.pinnedHint: Started and queued runs finish on the version they began with.
pipelines.name: Name
pipelines.startHint: Pick how v1 begins. Every step can be changed afterwards.
pipelines.copyHint: Its latest version becomes v1 of the copy.
pipelines.slugHint: Generated from the name. Fixed after the first publish.
pipelines.createHint: Create v1 saves it once every step has an agent profile or a tool; tasks can use it then.
pipelines.copyCreateHint: Create v1 saves the copy as its v1; tasks can use it then.
pipelines.runHint: Create a task to run this pipeline.
pipelines.toolBadge: Its exit code decides the step
pipelines.baseMoves: Merge the base branch when it moves
pipelines.baseMovesHint: On by default for steps that can write, except Review and Verify steps and steps that return their failures to a writing step.
pipelines.profileCommandsHint: Steps can only narrow profile permissions. {{profile}} allows {{commands}}.
pipelines.networkUnavailable: This profile and its connection cannot enforce turning network off on this platform.
pipelines.commandsUnavailable: This profile and its connection do not offer a command list that steps can narrow.
pipelines.askTools: Ask when a tool needs approval
pipelines.narrowHint: Steps can only narrow profile permissions.
pipelines.toolUnavailable: This tool cannot run as a pipeline step in this version.
pipelines.removeHint: Steps after it will follow its dependencies. Failure routes may need updating.
pipelines.stepNameHint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel
pipelines.error: The pipeline could not be saved
pipelines.renamedOnly: The new name was saved for the team; the steps were not. Save again to save them.
pipelines.conflict: The saved pipeline changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving; your unsaved changes will be replaced.
pipelines.firstVersion: First version. There is nothing older to compare with.

sourcesSection.label: Sources for every step
sourcesSection.description: Folders outside the worktree that every step's agent may read without asking. A run reads the project's, the task's, the pipeline's and the step's sources together.
sourcesSection.stepDetail: Folders and files outside the worktree this step's agent may read without asking.
sourcesSection.tasksToo: Each task adds its own sources too. A run reads the union and keeps it until it ends.
sourcesSection.untilSaved: Changes here reach runs once you save v{{version}}.
sourcesSection.loadFailed: The project's sources couldn't be read
sourcesSection.loadFailedBody: {{reason}} Nothing was changed. Sources can be added once the project's are read, since one the project already lists is not added again.

delivers.help: What a run that passes every step leaves. A run that commits nothing is completed when its result is a report, and waits for you when changes were expected. A task may say otherwise for its own runs.
delivers.changesHelp: Its commits are merged into the base branch.
delivers.reportHelp: Its last step's report is the result; no repository changes are expected.
delivers.outsideHelp: Done through MCP tools, e.g. a design or tickets: its report and the tool calls that changed something.
delivers.changesOrReportHelp: Its commits are merged when it makes any; otherwise its report is the result.

pipelines.descriptionHelp: Helps people choose it in New task.
pipelines.versionsExplanation: Saving publishes the next version. Tasks use the latest version; a run keeps the version it started with.
pipelines.settingsImpact: Save applies it to new runs; started runs keep their version.
pipelines.freeSlugRequired: Choose a name with a free slug.
pipelines.reviewVersionHint: New runs start on {{version}}. Nothing already started changes.
pipelines.publishedConsequence: New runs start on v{{version}}. Started and queued runs keep their version.
pipelines.slugPublished: Set when v1 was first published. Tasks and runs use it to identify this pipeline.
pipelines.profileDraftHint: {{name}} has only draft v1. Publish it before this pipeline can publish; runs use published profiles only.
pipelines.profileDraftModel: From the profile’s draft. It may change before {{name}} is published.
pipelines.profileWait: Finish the current save, review or reload before opening the profile.
pipelines.databaseUnavailable: Database actions cannot run as pipeline steps yet. Pick a command tool without access rules or an agent profile.
pipelines.httpUnavailable: HTTP actions cannot run as pipeline steps yet. Pick a command tool without access rules or an agent profile.
pipelines.toolAccessUnavailable: Pipeline steps cannot run command tools with access rules yet. Pick a command tool without access rules or an agent profile.
pipelines.noDeliverChip: No Deliver step · runs end in Ready for review
pipelines.leaveBody: Unsaved edits to this pipeline will be discarded. Saved versions are kept.
